text: Completed on isolated branch codex/multivar-lifecycle at bf7f82c. Runtime now distinguishes RequestedOptimizationClaim from evidence-bearing AchievedOptimizationGuarantee; Unresolved cannot be requested. SolverGuarantee, LatentEncodingAchievement, legacyAttainedGuarantee, and all runtime references were removed. ModelSpec policies accept achieved claim classes. Latent encoding now binds stationarity or unresolved evidence to the GLRM contract, encoder, observations/mask, decoder and penalties, latent parameter, and result while retaining the first-order certificate. ProgramSolverGuaranteeIr remains unchanged as the versioned 0.2 compatibility vocabulary, with explicit requested/achieved adapters. Evidence: multivar JVM+JS tests passed (449 each at full-suite run; new requested-claim law also passed on both), multivar-ir JVM 46 and JS 44 passed, mvpa-fit JVM+JS 38 each passed, and sbt compileAll passed. The only compileAll warnings were pre-existing unrelated graphics CompoundPolygon exhaustivity warnings.
